narrative.overview: A quietly turning cog, quick search, real expandable source-item groups, separated Settings, and a bottommost collapse control orient operators. The light or dark work surface makes mediated agent calls, accepted API starts and run events easy to follow. Cloud dashboards inspire density, not branding.
keyCharacteristics: Fast path from definition to run and events.
Real source and indexed facts only.
Consistent loading, empty, error, and focus states.

rules.name: The Recorded-State Rule
rules.body: A status color only describes a status actually returned by the API. Missing data is unavailable, not success.

dos: Do show manifest topology and sample limits.
Do preserve keyboard focus, mobile navigation and browser-local appearance choices.
donts: Don't imply mediated agent calls include direct sessions, accepted API starts include public webhooks, or events are spans.
Don't use decorative metrics cards or placeholder charts.
